items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I think maybe Mayeth had something to do with that.

ctx.x: How did Sidney Aroding, the White Clarence, how did he come to get on that date of yours?
Well, I don't know exactly but I know he was a close friend of Lee and I think maybe Mayeth had something to do with that. Yeah.
But he fitted in pretty well, don't he?
